summary: This bill expands the advanced manufacturing production tax credit to include copper produced from recycled materials with a minimum purity of 99.9 percent, effective for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands an existing advanced manufacturing production tax credit to include recycled copper. By broadening the scope of this credit, it effectively lowers the tax burden for companies engaged in this specific type of manufacturing, thus reducing overall tax revenue.
